entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: The human navigator and engineer of the Skyship Weatherlight, born on Tolaria, who dies of a Phyrexian plague during the Invasion.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship Hanna navigates and helps repair.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Hanna's birthplace on Dominaria, later razed to glass by Barrin.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Tolaria lies and which Yawgmoth enters.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Hanna's father, who left Urza's service after her death, exhumed her body, and razed Tolaria.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Hanna's mother and Barrin's wife.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The planeswalker whose Bloodline Project produced Hanna and whom Barrin served.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Inheritor of the Legacy artifacts and captain of the Weatherlight, whom Hanna loves.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A friend of Hanna from university and a healer on the Weatherlight crew who devises a cure too late.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A crew member in love with Gerrard who bonds with Hanna on Rath.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Barrin's protege who joins the crew and prepares the portal off Rath.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: A Weatherlight crewmate who died during the attack on Crovax's Estate.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member who was abducted and later helped recover the Power Matrix.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: The leader of the Skyshroud elves who allies with the crew.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Attacker aboard the Predator who captured Karn and Tahngarth.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member captured by Greven il-Vec.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member captured by Greven il-Vec.

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: A soltari who informs Hanna that Ertai has prepared the portal off Rath.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane the Weatherlight reaches, where the crew encounters the Predator and the Stronghold.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: The plane where the Weatherlight crash-lands and the crew is arrested.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: The people who took the Weatherlight believing it to be Ramos come again.

entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: A Cho-Arrim who intercedes to find the real thief of the Power Matrix.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A villain disguised as a crew member who orchestrated the crew's troubles on Mercadia.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A legendary figure who himself comes to the Weatherlight's aid.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on Dominaria during which Hanna contracts a plague.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler who tempted Gerrard with the promise of restoring Hanna and whose death cloud made the dead rise.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A being who created a figurehead for the Weatherlight in Hanna's honor.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin who remained in Mercadia City with Hanna and helped the crew escape.

events.summary: Hanna leaves Tolaria to study artifice at Argivian University in New Argive, becoming estranged from her father.
events.quote: Hanna and Barrin were not on speaking terms for many years as a result.

events.summary: Hanna befriends Orim at university and the two join the crew of the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Hanna befriended Orim while at the university, and later the pair joined the crew of Weatherlight .

events.summary: Gerrard leaves after Rofellos dies, leaving Hanna feeling abandoned; years later he rejoins and love rekindles.
events.quote: leading Hanna to feel abandoned and betrayed by his departure.

events.summary: Hanna loses a competition to Ertai, who then derides her artifacts.
events.quote: Hanna challenged Ertai to a competition which she ultimately lost

events.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and Tahngarth are captured and Gerrard is thrown overboard, so Hanna takes charge of the ship.
events.quote: Hanna took charge of the ship with Mirri 's support and landed the ship in the forest below.

events.summary: Hanna defeats a shapeshifter and bonds with Mirri, then both are taken prisoner by the Skyshroud elves.
events.quote: through ingenuity, Hanna managed to defeat the monster.

events.summary: Gerrard, proclaimed the Korvecdal, allies the crew with the elven rebels, who help them into the Stronghold.
events.quote: proclaimed the Korvecdal by the Oracle en -Vec , leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels.

events.summary: Lyna tells Hanna that Ertai has prepared the portal off Rath and the crew leaves.
events.quote: When the soltari Lyna appeared to inform her that Ertai had prepared the portal off of Rath and demanded that they leave

events.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia, the Cho-Arrim attack, and Hanna and others are arrested.
events.quote: The Weatherlight crash-landed on Mercadia after departing Rath.

events.summary: The crew escapes Mercadia City with the Cho-Arrim prisoners and learns of the myths of Ramos.
events.quote: Here, they learned of the myths of Ramos and why the Cho-Arrim had taken the Weatherlight to begin with

events.summary: The Power Matrix is stolen and the women are framed; Cho-Manno finds the real thief too late.
events.quote: the Power Matrix was stolen shortly after their arrival, and the women were framed for the crime.

events.summary: Volrath's plot is revealed; during the Revolution on Mercadia the crew escapes aboard the empowered Weatherlight with Ramos's help.
events.quote: Weatherlight managed to escape when Ramos himself came to their aid.

events.summary: Hanna contracts a Phyrexian plague at the start of the Invasion and dies hours before Orim's cure is ready.
events.quote: Soon, Orim devised a cure, but it came hours too late to save her.

events.summary: Barrin leaves Urza's service, exhumes Hanna's body, reburies her on Tolaria next to his wife, and razes the island to glass.
events.quote: Reburying her next to his wife, he then razed the island to glass.

events.summary: Yawgmoth tempts Gerrard with a false promise to revive Hanna.
events.quote: Yawgmoth later tempted Gerrard with the promise of bringing his beloved back to life, but that was only an elaborate ruse.

events.summary: Yawgmoth's death cloud briefly turns Hanna, Barrin and Rayne into undead.
events.quote: Barrin, Rayne and Hanna were all briefly turned into undead during the last stage of the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
